info.name: Content Service - Showcase CRUD
info.description:
Sample requests/responses CRUD showcase (ContentDetailShowcase) pada content-service.

Semua endpoint admin, dilindungi JWT (Authorization: Bearer) + role super_admin/admin_pusat/admin_pustik.

Base URL local dev: http://localhost:4076/content-service/api

Endpoints:
1. GET    /showcase/side-menu          - daftar parent content tipe showcase
2. GET    /showcase/list/{contentId}    - list showcase per content (paginated)
3. POST   /showcase                    - buat showcase
4. GET    /showcase/{id}               - detail showcase
5. PUT    /showcase/{id}               - update showcase
6. DELETE /showcase/{id}               - hapus showcase
